channel.title: The Signal
channel.description: A daily briefing on developments that changed the picture today, with maps, full reports and sources.

item.title: Monday 19 October 2026
item.description:
Russia answered Ukraine's weekend drone raid with an overnight strike on the grid that cut power to 550,000 homes, while US sanctions on Moscow stay paused. In Yemen, Houthi missiles killed at least 18 soldiers at an army camp even as Riyadh's airport reopened and oil eased toward $108. France's prime minister asked towns to impose curfews, and cost-of-living clashes spread to Milan. Albertans finish voting today on whether to start down the road out of Canada, and Israel's election, eight days off, is deadlocked.

  • Russia strikes back at Ukraine's grid, cutting power to 550,000 homes
  • Houthi missiles kill at least 18 soldiers at a Yemeni army camp
  • France turns to curfews as cost-of-living clashes reach Milan
  • Israel's election is deadlocked, and Trump endorses Netanyahu
  • Alberta votes on separation after 1.3 million ballots cast early
  • Congo's Ebola outbreak reaches an eighth province
  • Super Typhoon Champi heads for the Philippines and Taiwan after skirting Guam
  • Brazil's runoff tightens after a chaotic first debate
  • Australian MP critically hurt in what Albanese calls a deliberate attack

item.title: Sunday 18 October 2026
item.description:
France counted the cost of its worst unrest in years, and Macron answered with a promise of accountability and local protest bans. Ukraine sent more than a thousand drones into Russia hours after Washington waived the sanctions meant to squeeze Moscow's oil money. Brent crude sits near $110 as the Saudi–Houthi war widens, and Ebola is spreading person to person in Kenya for the first time. Two votes are close: Alberta decides tomorrow whether to start down the road out of Canada, and Brazil picks a president next Sunday.

  • France counts the damage, and waits for Macron
  • Ukraine sends 1,000 drones into Russia as Washington waives sanctions
  • Oil nears $110 as the Saudi–Houthi war widens
  • Ebola is now spreading inside Kenya
  • Alberta votes tomorrow on starting the road out of Canada
  • Trump's approval hits a record low with 16 days to go
  • Brazil's runoff is a coin toss, one week out
  • Settlers attack European diplomats as Washington tells Israel to crack down
  • Pakistan and the Taliban keep trading fire on the border
